'''Neka''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]]. During the [[Jedi Civil War]], it was subject to a [[Darth Revan's Sith Empire|Sith]] [[Blockade/Legends|blockade]] which stopped incoming and outgoing space traffic. The Sith then [[Viral bomb/Legends|virus-bombed]] the world, killing all of its intelligent life. Only a few fortunate individuals, including the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] businessman [[Shuma (Hutt)|Shuma]], were able to bypass the blockade and escape the devastation. It shares its name with the [[Neka nut]].
